description: Add timestamp data to match history and improve the overall UI design with clear match ordering indicators, polished visuals, and improved layout
steps: Step 1 - Add gameStartTimestamp to types and API: In lib/types.ts, add a 'gameStartTimestamp' field (number) to RiotMatchInfo interface and a 'gameStartTimestamp' field (number) to MatchSummary interface. In app/api/riot/route.ts, extract match.info.gameStartTimestamp (fallback to match.info.gameCreation or Date.now()) and include it in the MatchSummary object returned. Also add 'gameStartTimestamp' to the ApiSuccessResponse type if needed.

Step 2 - Create a time-ago utility: Create lib/time-ago.ts with a function formatTimeAgo(timestamp: number): string that returns relative time strings like '2 minutes ago', '1 hour ago', '3 days ago'. Handle edge cases (future timestamps, very old timestamps).

Step 3 - Update MatchHistory component: In app/components/MatchHistory.tsx, pass a 'matchIndex' prop (0-based index from the map) and a 'totalMatches' count to each MatchCard. Add a subheading below 'Recent Matches' that says 'Ordered from most recent to oldest' to clarify the ordering.

Step 4 - Update MatchCard component: In app/components/MatchCard.tsx, accept 'matchIndex' (number) and 'totalMatches' (number) as props. Display a match number badge (e.g. '#1' for most recent) in the top-left or left side of the card. Show a relative timestamp (using formatTimeAgo) from match.gameStartTimestamp. For the first match (index 0), show a 'Most Recent' badge/label. Ensure the layout remains responsive and accessible.

Step 5 - Polish overall UI design: Improve the visual hierarchy across components. In app/page.tsx, enhance the header with a subtle gradient or icon. In app/components/SearchForm.tsx, add subtle visual improvements (better spacing, focus states). In app/components/RegionSelector.tsx, improve the selector styling. Ensure all components have consistent spacing, refined borders, and polished hover/focus states. Make the MatchCard more visually distinct with better use of color, spacing, and typography. Add subtle transitions/animations where appropriate.
Step 6 - Update MatchDetailModal: Add the game timestamp display in the modal header showing when the match was played (formatted as relative time).
Step 7 - Run npm run lint and npm run build to verify everything passes cleanly with zero errors. Fix any TypeScript or lint errors that arise.
acceptance_criteria: API route extracts and returns gameStartTimestamp from Riot API response
Each MatchCard displays a match number indicator (e.g. #1 for most recent)
The first/most recent match has a visible 'Most Recent' label
Each MatchCard shows a relative time-ago label (e.g. '2 hours ago')
The MatchHistory section heading clearly indicates ordering (most recent first)
Overall UI has improved visual polish (better spacing, typography, hover states)
All components remain fully responsive on mobile/tablet/desktop
Semantic HTML and ARIA labels are used properly
npm run lint passes with zero errors
npm run build passes with zero errors
